defects.area: /scores search, period and cabinet tabs, Show more; profile game tabs
defects.found: The hosted views rebuild their DOM on every render and render again when the index answers, dropping keyboard focus to <body>. On /scores, typing '0x88', waiting for the results and typing '41' left the box at '0x88': the later keys went nowhere. Period tabs and cabinet banners lost focus after their board loaded, Show more at once, and the profile game tabs the moment they were pressed.
defects.fix: New lazy apps/portal/src/focus-keeper.mjs restores the focused control (and caret) after each hosted re-render; Show more uses aria-disabled while loading and hands focus to the row count after the last page; profile tabs gain data-game, aria-pressed and a labelled group.

defects.found: On a first visit the picker opened before src/styles/wallet-picker.css (loaded on first use) applied, and painted as page content under the footer: a bullet list with browser-grey buttons ('WCWALLETCONNECT…') and run-together links. Seen live on /games/stacked at 390 px; reproduced on / with the CSS delayed.
defects.fix: Until the stylesheet applies, inline stand-ins make the backdrop a fixed dimmed layer at once while the sheet stays hidden; the CSS then takes over (inline styles dropped). After 3 s or on a CSS error the sheet shows on a legible fallback, never as page content, and later sheets on that page skip the wait; focus moves in once it shows.

defects.found: Another wallet's public profile was headed 'Guest Practice Profile' under 'Guest practice session', with the lead 'Sign in with a wallet to see your verified Ranked runs…'.
defects.fix: Header 'Player Profile', eyebrow 'Public profile · 0x8841…e824', flag-aware PORTAL_COPY.profilePublicView lead; the viewer's own and the signed-out /profile keep theirs.

defects.area: Generic buttons: profile Share profile, View Leaderboard, View my profile, Try again, Sign in, Retry, Retry saved runs; Ranked entry Switch network / Get zkLTC / Check again; the first-Ranked name toast's Not now

defects.fix: Cyan-outline arcade button for them (text 17:1 on its base, 44 px target, gold focus ring); avatar options get an outlined tile. A test keeps every pixel-button variant styled.
